description: SolarStations is a public catalogue of multi-component solar irradiance monitoring stations. The GitHub README points to an interactive map and invites station additions and corrections. A modeller can find station locations and follow their metadata to identify suitable measured irradiance for a solar generation case. The resource is a registry of stations, not a consolidated archive of every measurement at those sites. Geographic coverage is global where stations have been listed; completeness and continued operation vary by provider. GitHub metadata states BSD-3-Clause licensing for the repository. A limitation is that each station's data access, temporal coverage, calibration and local shading need verification with its operator before use. The registry can guide validation of solar-resource inputs for grid or PV models. The related catalogue ERA5 reanalysis is a gridded weather product, not a station registry. No station observations were downloaded.
name: SolarStations irradiance station catalogue
